title: Region-aware evidence pipeline & notification API for residency and retention events
creator: Liam O'Connor
description: Implement a region-aware Compliance Events API and webhook delivery pipeline that emits structured events for data residency changes, retention policy updates, and automated evidence artifacts. The API should provide subscription management, schema versioning, signed delivery, and replayability so customers and auditors can reliably consume and verify compliance events.
background: Customers operating under data residency and retention regulations have asked for an auditable, machine-readable stream of residency decisions, retention policy changes, and packaged evidence derived from logs/exports. Existing work addressed basic audit webhooks and export endpoints, but lacks region constraints, evidence packaging details, and a robust delivery/replay system for long-term audits.
scope: Create a Compliance Events API endpoint (POST/GET for subscriptions), a region-partitioned event bus, webhook delivery workers with signing and retries, an evidence artifact packaging format (manifest + signed attachments), and an admin console view for subscriptions and delivery health. Provide SDK examples and an integration test harness.
out_of_scope: Long-term archival storage UI, per-customer custom encryption key onboarding (KMS/HSM onboarding is tracked in a separate ticket), fine-grained consent interfaces for end-users. This ticket will not implement on-prem agent for air-gapped customers.
acceptance_criteria: Customers can create/update/delete subscriptions scoped to region and event types via the Compliance Events API
Webhook deliveries are HMAC-signed with rotating keys and documented verification steps
At-least-once delivery semantics with exponential backoff and DLQ for failed deliveries is in place
Evidence artifacts are produced as a signed manifest pointing to timebounded, region-tagged blobs (signed URLs) and stored with lifecycle metadata
Integration tests simulate a regional outage and show automatic failover to configured fallback region within SLA
API documentation and SDK example for subscribing, validating signatures, and replaying past events are published
tasks: Design event schema and manifest format (schema registry entries)
Implement subscription management endpoints and RBAC checks
Build region-partitioned Kafka topic + producer library
Implement webhook delivery worker with signing, retries, and DLQ
Evidence packager service: assemble manifest, generate signed URLs, attach retention metadata
Console: subscription list + delivery health + manual replay tool
End-to-end integration tests and chaos test for region failover
Create developer docs and SDK samples (Node/Python)
Security review and threat model for PII in payloads
decisions: Use at-least-once delivery semantics with idempotency keys for consumers rather than attempting exactly-once guarantees across regions
Sign webhook payloads with rotating RSA keys and publish a JWKS endpoint for consumers to verify
Partition the event bus by region and customer_id to make residency guarantees auditable and to simplify retention enforcement
tradeoffs: Choosing at-least-once simplifies delivery and allows replay but requires consumers to be idempotent
Storing evidence artifacts in region-located object stores increases cost but ensures stronger residency assertions
Using signed URLs vs proxying attachments reduces bandwidth on our API plane but requires short-lived URL handling and secure access controls
risks_mitigation: Risk: webhook delivery to customer endpoints may expose PII — Mitigation: allow filtering of PII fields, deliver minimal manifests with links to region-scoped blobs
Risk: key rotation causing verification failures — Mitigation: support overlapping key validity and publish historical keys for replay window

Risk: cross-region failover breaking residency guarantees — Mitigation: replication policies will tag events with original_region and effective_region; policy will disallow moving PII blobs unless customer configured cross-region backups
